title: Heed the Words of Jesus in Holy Qur'an
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Dastoor yaa Sayyidi yaa Mawla, madad yaa Sultan. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illaLlah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Anta Subhaan! Anta Sultan! tu` izzu man tasha' wa
tudhillu man tashsha' Subhaanak, narju rahmatak wa nakhsha adhaabak inna ibaadaka d`uafa yaa Rabbana
bi rahmatika bi fadlika bi jaahi nabiyyina Muhammad alfu, alfu, alfu salaatu wa 's-salaam.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings) Welcome to you! Welcome to you! Welcome to you!
I am a weak servant, as everyone is a weak one. Don't think that if you are a king or emperor or malik or
sultan, you are going to be a strong, powerful one, no. The level of all Mankind is level of weak servants. And
we are saying a` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, because we know we are weak ones. Our enemy
is also a weak one but he can do countless trips and traps to make Mankind, the Children of Adam, pbuh, to
be caught through its traps. Therefore, we have been ordered to say a` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'rrajeem.
O People! Don't trust your physical body’s strength or your treasures. O People! Don't trust your sovereignty.

You think that such things are making you strong or powerful? No. We must say and accept that we are weak
servants. Allah, Allah. Nahnu ` abeeduka 'd-d`uafa. We are saying, "O our Lord, we are Your weak servants,"
because our lives are between two breathings, one entering and one going out. If you are putting your head
under water, or a rope around your neck for five minutes, you are finished. How are we saying we are
powerful? How? Yes, we must say, "We are weak servants." That is important and that is the real description
of servants. Servants, can't be powerful. (It is for the One) Who created them, not for you. Don't say, "I am a
king, an emperor, or padishah." That is a title and it is cheating you. Man is created and his creation is weak;
that is his description. He may trust his out-looking (appearance), showing himself a hero, leave him.
Therefore say, a` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. When we say a` oodhu billahi min ashShaytaani 'r-rajeem, we are accepting that we are weak ones and we are running away. And Shaytan is
running after you as a dog is running after a boy, who is asking to escape. Shaytan is just like this, a dog
running after you, asking to bite you. Therefore, the Lord of Heavens is knowing and ordering, "O My
servants, you must know your weakness and ask some support for saving you from Shaytan's dog."
People, everywhere now, are never saying a` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem because they are
friendly with Shaytan, and if friendly, why are they going to say a` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'rrajeem? The sign of our servanthood is to ask protection from our Creator. We are saying, "O our Lord, we
are Your weak servants. We can't do anything." Almost every trouble, every crisis, every suffering, every
misery is only from shaytanic trips or traps. Shaytan is making people to fall into troubles. He is so happy if
he is seeing Mankind in troubles, or if he is seeing that Mankind is coming to a cross-way and not knowing
which way to go. Shaytan is coming and saying, "O wondering people, follow me! Follow me!" And ignorant
ones, who are not taking any care or any lesson from heavenly messages are saying, "Oh, that must be our
savior, we must follow that one." They are following him and falling into trouble on troubles, trouble on
troubles. SubhaanAllah 'l-`Aliyyi 'l-`Azheem. A` oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'rRahmaani 'r-Raheem.
O our listeners! Listen, this is an addressing to people from east to west and from north to south. Allah
Almighty can do as He likes. He may bring a small one for warning. Yes? Is it mentioned through the Holy
Qur'an? Say? O Christian world and Israeli world! What are you knowing about Jesus Christ, what are you
thinking? O our Salafi `ulama, what is your opinion about Jesus Christ? And he was in his bed, a small baby.
The looking (view) of Muslims is something, the looking of Jewish people for that baby is something else and

the Christian world's looking is much more different. Say! O Salafi `ulama, why Allah Almighty made Jesus
Christ speak and address everyone around himself? Then that circle was getting bigger, bigger, bigger, bigger.
Why did Allah Almighty make Jesus Christ speak when he was in the cradle?
The Holy Qur'an (it is written) oceans, oceans and addressing all people according to their levels. Why did
Allah Almighty create Jesus Christ and no father? A materialist or a naturalist person may say that is
impossible, dhaalika mablaghuhum min al-` ilm, that is the last horizon they are knowing. Why are you not
saying from the beginning, that one drop of water is coming together from a man and a woman, making a
baby. Why are you not saying about that one? You are saying it is impossible. He Who may make possible to
create a man from two drops, may create a man from one drop also. How it can be? (It) may be! He may put
through one drop two kinds of living ones to reach each other to make one egg. He may do as He likes.
Without using two drops, through one drop He may put male and female spots and therefore, may create.
Nothing prevents Allah Almighty!
•••••••• •••••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••••• •••• ••••••• •••• •••• •••••••••
Innamaa amruhoo idhaa araada shayy'an an yaqoola lahoo kun fayakoon. Verily, when He intends a thing,
His Command is, "Be," and it is! (36:82)
He is Allah. If He is asking something to come in existence, He may do that, saying, "Be a man, one drop. I
am that One that just programmed your life to move forward. I am mussabiba 'l-asbaab, without anything, I
created Adam. I ordered one drop to carry at the same time a male and a female spot, making through that
one a baby, Jesus Christ."
He can do as He likes, fa` alullima yureed (85:16). No objecting on Allah Almighty's shu` oon, as He likes. He
Almighty is asking from one drop that a female is carrying to bring a child and He ordered that child to be
male, not female. This is for all nations who are believing in Allah Almighty and in His endless quwwat
(power), He may do everything. Accepting. Qaadiru Muqtadir. And He created Sayyidina `Isa, pbuh, Jesus
Christ to come from one drop as a man, without his mother touching any male. The Lord of Heavens was
making this according to His will. Allah Almighty was bringing that baby in front of people and all nations
and saying, "Just new, created," and that baby was coming and sitting ( ... ) warning whole Mankind that
time, "O People! I am now speaking to you".

••••••••••• •••••••• ••• ••••••••• ••••••••• •••••• •••••••••••••
Wa yukallimu 'n-naasa fi 'l-mahdi wa kahlan wa mina 's-saaliheen. "He shall speak to the people in childhood
and maturity and he shall be (of the company) of the righteous." (3:46)
Why did He say kahla? Allah Almighty was teaching His servants, "They are coming after Jesus Christ," for
the nation of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s.) (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) The Lord of Heavens
can do that; a warning that people can't be able to understand and (at the) same time the Lord of Heavens,
the Creator of Jesus Christ was saying, "I can do anything as I like. Don't put limits or conditions on My Will.
I am that One Who can do everything." Don't say this and that. Keep your good adab, manners. Therefore,
Allah Almighty was making a warning at that time.
Don't say, “Who is that one who is shouting every night and saying something? And we are not
understanding from where he is speaking." O Salafi `ulama! Are you thinking that Jesus Christ was going to
school through his mom's womb and coming out and speaking? If you are saying, "We are Muslims," are you
believing in the Holy Qur'an? Why are you not asking how Jesus Christ without going to school became an
`alim? Believe in Allah! Don't say, “How is this person coming every night and speaking to us, saying this and
that?” I am nothing. I am like a cane. If full inside, it can't say anything. If you are making a hole and making
like this (mimics musical notes, singing a tune), "Now I can't say," but with this you must say that this is our
Lord's servant and antumu 'l-khalaaiq, kullu naas, (you, o people, are the creation, all mankind):
nahnu al-khalaaiq kulluna `abeed, (we are the creation, all of are servants)
w'al-ilaahu feenaa yafa`al maa yureed, (and our God with us, will do as He pleases)
Anything wrong? Not wrong. Every wrong thing belongs to ourselves, it never belongs to our Creator! He can
do anything!
I am saying therefore that that servant is like a cane and he is blowing that cane and so many things are
coming; some of them you are understanding, and some you are not. O Salafi `ulama, be ready for
understanding. If you ask, you may be granted and if not asking, you haven't been granted. Therefore,
something that has been granted to us is a warning for whole nations; why have they been falling through
endless troubles and miseries? And you are saying you never like it. Understand! Allah knows, Allah knows.

This is a warning, as the Lord of Heavens says, His warning is coming through a newborn boy. And they say
from that time up to today, 2000 years, that small one's warning is going on but they are not taking the right
meaning and Shaytan is making them to go to this side or that side.
O People! We must be believers and if you like to be in safety and be under heavenly protection against every
badness and misery, you must follow the Holy Qur'an. Look there. Look! The Lord of Heavens is warning all
nations (through `Isa (as.)) "O People! My Lord created me, I am His servant." Addressing Jewish people, "O
my people, I am from you but I am saying that I am the warner for my nation, warning them from Shaytan.
That is my Lord's will, and from so many tricks and traps if you are not coming and believing, you shall be
ashamed on the Day of Resurrection."
You must believe the Lord of all Creation can do anything as He likes, and if making a small one for warning,
what about an old one to say something? And making me a warner for all nations; not only for Muslims, not
only for Christians, not only for Jewish people! The Last Day is approaching, take your care! And finally, "I
am that one, only speaking to you, I am on that one, (from the) mahd, cradle. I am speaking now to make it
100 percent satisfaction through yourself. I am coming once again kahlan, 40 years and more. That time I am
speaking to you." And no doubt a 40-year-old person may speak, but he had been raised to the heavens in
that period. He was speaking to people, saying, “I am a servant to my Lord, and He has made me address you,
and in a miraculous way I am speaking to you and I am warning you. I am going to the heavens and I am
coming once again through My Lord's order when the Last Days are approaching, to address people and to
warn them. That shall be the last warning. If you are not accepting, you shall go down to hells. If accepting, I
am coming a second time to speak to you and I shall not be an old man but 40 years old."
This is a humble association that they are ordering a weak servant saying, "You are sitting down and we are
sending." I don't know. O People! Marhaban, marhaban, marhaban! O Listeners! Take something, even one
sentence, that you can be saved by the honor of that one who had been honored from pre-Eternal to Eternal.
Jesus Christ was saying, "I am coming, giving good tidings to you about Sayyidina Muhammad (s) (Mawlana
Shaykh stands), and he is coming for all time."
May Allah forgive us.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultaan Allah
Dome dome dome dome, Dome dome dome dome 4x
Fatihah.
(53 minutes)
Oh, mashaa-Allah, mashaa-Allah. (Mawlana Shaykh laughs.) How many people? (503,000)
May Allah forgive us.
